Liko and Roy's Departure |plain_title=Pocket Monsters: Liko and Roy's Departure |image=Pocket Monsters Liko and Roy Departure logo.png |size=240px |arc=Arc |number=1 |opening=Heart-Pounding Diary |ending=RVR ~Rising Volt Tacklers Rap~ |numeps=25 ([[HZ001]]-[[HZ025]]) |region=[[Kanto]], [[Paldea]], [[Galar]] |series=''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]'' |nextlink=The Sparkling of Terapagos |next=Pocket Monsters: The Sparkling of Terapagos |seo= }} (Japanese: '''リコとロイの旅立ち''' ''Liko and Roy's Depature'') is the first arc of {{aniseries|HZ}} that aired on [[TV Tokyo]] from April 14, 2023 to October 20, 2023. It is followed by ''[[The Sparkling of Terapagos]]'' arc. The arc focuses on new {{pkmn|Trainer}}s [[Liko]] and [[Roy]], and their {{pkmn2|first partner}}s, {{TP|Liko|Sprigatito}} and {{TP|Roy|Fuecoco}}, as they join a group of adventurers named the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] and discover their connection to the Ancient Adventurer [[Lucius]] and a [[Terapagos (anime)|mysterious Pokémon]] living in Liko's pendant. The arc also introduces the [[Explorers]], an opposing faction bent on taking Liko's pendant for themselves. The arc's opening theme is [[Heart-Pounding Diary]] performed by {{wp|Asmi (singer)|asmi}} feat. {{jwp|Chinozo}}, and the ending theme is [[RVR ~Rising Volt Tacklers Rap~]] by Liko (CV: [[Minori Suzuki]]) & Roy (CV: [[Yuka Terasaki]]). {{spoilers}} ==Plot== [[Liko]], a beginner Trainer from [[Paldea]], enrolls at [[Indigo Academy]] in [[Kanto]] and receives {{TP|Liko|Sprigatito}} as her [[first partner Pokémon]]. She encounters [[Amethio]] and becomes targeted by the mysterious organization called [[Explorers]] due to her pendant, which briefly reveals a mysterious Pokémon. [[Friede]] and the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] intervene, rescuing Sprigatito from Amethio's captivity, and Liko joins their crew as they head for Paldea. Upon arriving in Paldea, Liko meets [[Roy]], who befriends a stowaway {{TP|Roy|Fuecoco}} traveling with the Rising Volt Tacklers. When the Explorers attack [[Roy's hometown]], his [[Ancient Poké Ball]] opens to reveal a [[Black Rayquaza]] before it flies away. Roy catches Fuecoco and joins the Rising Volt Tacklers. After this incident, [[Gibeon]] removes Amethio from the mission and assigns it to [[Spinel]] instead. [[Dot]], who streams as the popular Nidothing, eventually tags along with Liko and Roy. The group discovers a {{pkmn2|giant}} {{p|Arboliva}} holding another Ancient Poké Ball, which goes into the ball under Liko's care. They learn about [[Lucius]], an ancient adventurer connected to the Ancient Poké Balls. After Spinel steals Liko's pendant, the group travels to [[Levincia]] where Dot catches her first Pokémon, {{TP|Dot|Quaxly}}, and helps retrieve the pendant. The Rising Volt Tacklers then journey to [[Galar]], where Liko catches a {{TP|Liko|Hatenna}} and they locate Lucius's third Pokémon, a {{rf|Galarian}} {{p|Moltres}}, which joins Liko's care. The mysterious Pokémon from the pendant fully emerges and is identified as [[Pagogo|Terapagos]] when the group meets Liko's grandmother [[Diana]] at her castle. The arc concludes with Diana tagging along with the Rising Volt Tacklers and revealing that Lucius's [[Six Heroes|remaining three]] Pokémon are {{p|Lapras}}, {{p|Kleavor}}, and {{p|Entei}}.
